description:
Activate Insight Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, putting a charge counter on Insight Engine and then drawing a card for each charge counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2 one additional time.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Insight Engine.
Repeat.

uses.name: Insight Engine
uses.cardState: with two or more charge counters on it
